title: Profession
description: Profession Ledger profession. Projected as a feat Item; every top-level field is kept in the Item's source definition.

name.description: Must contain one of: Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Cooking, Enchanting, Engineering, Inscription, Jewelcrafting, Leatherworking, Tailoring, Archaeology, Fishing, Herbalism, Hunting/Skinning, Mining (a [TAG] prefix is ignored).

access.description: Who qualifies (Ledger 0.16.0 Assign tab and GM Setup tools table). Skill names ('Nature') or dnd5e ids ('nat'); tool names ('Herbalism Kit') or dnd5e keys ('herb'). Names that match no dnd5e skill/tool are ignored. Only read when the profession name is one of the Ledger's 14 professions.

advantageToolsAnyOf.description: Shown to the GM as a suggestion; only tools the GM ticks in GM Setup give advantage.

toolMustBePresent.description: Stored with the definition; not enforced by any module yet.

workstation.description: Free text; shown on the recipe card.

progression.description: Reference data; the Ledger's level/XP rules are fixed in code (16 levels, cost 5+3n).
